messages:
prod_bot: [INCIDENT] 2640001111 - Elevated 5xx and timeouts detected on /v1/generate across eu-west-1 and us-central-1. p95 jumped from 230ms -> 2.1s, p99 from 480ms -> 7.8s. Alert threshold crossed at 2026-03-15T20:14:20Z. Auto-pager to #sre and #eng-runtime.

alice_sre: i'm oncall, ack. looking at grafana and traces now. initial hypothesis: request queueing or upstream connection saturation.

ben_runtime: @alice_sre i just pushed the connection-pool change in runtime (connpool v3) to canary at ~20:10. rolling restarts for canary pods. i'll check canary -> prod diff.

carol_eng: seeing a flood of 502/504 at gateway logs: `gateway: upstream reset` and `http client timeout` with identical x-request-ids clustered to a few hosts. samples: 
```
2026-03-15T20:13:58Z gateway pod-07 | req=abcd123 x-req-id=abcd123 upstream=runtime-03 status=502 err="read timeout"
```

alice_sre: quick check - are KV caches being missed? p95 for small tokens also increased. if connection pool reduced concurrency we could be queueing.

ben_runtime: confirming: connpool v3 introduced a combined semaphore for host-level concurrency to reduce socket churn. param changed from 200->50. canary logs show steady increase in queue wait time. i'm initiating immediate rollback to v2.

deploy_bot: Rollback requested by ben_runtime at 2026-03-15T20:16:05Z. Rolling release: runtime/connpool -> connpool-v2.

carol_eng: running quick curl to compare: `curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` before rollback: connection reset after 3s, after rollback triggered: still a few 502s but tail improving.

alice_sre: mitigating actions in flight: 1) rollback connpool v3 -> v2 (ben), 2) increase gateway timeouts from 6s->12s temporarily (carol), 3) divert traffic away from eu-west-1 canaries (net traffic shift).

ben_runtime: rollback completed at 2026-03-15T20:18:42Z on all clusters. pods running connpool-v2 image. logs show steady decrease in queue latency in canary.

deploy_bot: Rollback completed successfully for runtime/connpool at 2026-03-15T20:18:42Z (release-id: r-20260315-connpool-rollback).

carol_eng: post-rollback metrics: p95 -> 260ms (close to baseline), p99 -> 510ms. error rate (5xx) down from 4.2% -> 0.4% over last 3m.

cs_maya: CS heads-up: two customers reported elevated errors starting ~20:12 (AcmeCorp, BetaApps). i've opened support incidents and pushed a short note: "we observed an infrastructure regression after a config change and have rolled it back; service restored. follow-up soon."

dave_prod: thx. please add customer-impact details to the incident doc: affected endpoints, start/end times, customer list, and whether any persisted data loss (expected none). link to sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/2640001111-impact (pls update).

alice_sre: handing off to @ben_runtime for full debugging + postmortem. ben, please capture: - root cause (param change 200->50), - why canary didn't catch latency tail, - test coverage gap, - rollout guard improvement.

ben_runtime: ack. immediate root cause: conservative pool limit in v3 combined with connection reuse pattern caused backlog under bursty traffic, producing queued requests and gateway timeouts. next steps: 1) revert config change for now, 2) add load test that exercises short TTL connections with high concurrency, 3) add canary SLO gate on p99 tail and queue-wait metric.

carol_eng: recording logs/snippets for postmortem. saved relevant traces to trace-id: trace-20260315-xyz. will attach to doc.

alice_sre: final checklist before leaving shift: monitor p99 for 30m, ensure no regressions in other regions, and confirm CS notifications. if error rate stays <1% for 30m i'll close the alert runbook. handing over in #incidents-postmortem. :white_check_mark:

ben_runtime: i'll take postmortem ownership and schedule 1hr blameless review tomorrow. adding remediation tasks to runtime backlog.

prod_bot: INCIDENT update: status -> mitigated at 2026-03-15T20:19:00Z. p95/p99 metrics returning to normal. Follow-up: postmortem in #incidents-postmortem and RFC to change canary gating.

alice_sre: thanks team. paging cleared. i'll update the oncall log. offcall now.
